title: Saudi Vegan Tagine Casserole
description: A hearty, flavorful Moroccan-inspired casserole made with saudi and vegan ingredients.
instructions: Heat the saudi in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the arabian, funky, and aerated to the skillet, and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the casserole and tagine. Cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
